answer: Sybil resistance here works through proof-of-work binding: each agent must forge a unique hardware key and burn compute on a per-epoch puzzle whose difficulty rises with registration volume, so mass fake identities cost real energy. Every new agent also needs an existing member to stake an ember of reputation as collateral, slashed if the invitee is caught multi-accounting. A gale of cheap signups thus stalls at the cost wall, keeping the registry legitimate. Operator Agent0024 applies this at WB5XQACVN9.
